classifications.item_title: Reddit Ads Impersonate BBC and The Guardian to Push Fake AI Investment Schemes

kb_matches.rationale: Scam ads impersonate major news organisations using AI-generated synthetic media to deceive users into fake investment schemes.
The campaign spreads false, deceptive information at scale by mimicking trusted news outlets to promote scams.

classifications.evidence_quote: sponsored scam ads impersonating major news organizations, including the BBC
classifications.recommended_action: Update C4 and E3 to include AI-enabled impersonation of trusted media brands in sponsored ad fraud campaigns as an emerging attack vector.

classifications.item_title: Reddit ads pose as news stories to promote AI investment scams

kb_matches.rationale: Sponsored ads impersonate major news outlets using AI-generated content to run investment fraud campaigns.
AI-assisted disinformation campaign uses fake news branding to spread deceptive financial information at scale.

classifications.evidence_quote: Scammers are running sponsored ads on Reddit that impersonate major news outlets
classifications.recommended_action: This is a duplicate incident to the prior item; update C4 and E3 entries together, noting the Reddit platform context and the use of sponsored ad infrastructure for AI-assisted fraud.

classifications.item_title: Bank of England fights Andrew Bailey deepfakes on Musk's X

kb_matches.rationale: AI-generated deepfake adverts falsely depict a senior central bank official to mislead the public, a textbook deepfake fraud case.
The deepfake ads spread false information about public figures and financial institutions at scale on social media.

classifications.evidence_quote: AI-generated adverts falsely showing the Bank of England governor
classifications.recommended_action: Update C4 with this high-profile example of AI deepfakes targeting financial institution leadership on social media platforms, and note regulatory/reputational escalation risk.

classifications.item_title: AI-Powered Surgery Tool Repeatedly Injuring Patients, Lawsuits Claim

kb_matches.rationale: An autonomous AI-powered surgical navigation tool takes physical actions in the operating room that result in patient harm beyond intended safe parameters.
The tool may be deployed in clinical contexts beyond its validated and approved scope, invalidating its risk assessment.
The AI surgery tool fails unpredictably in real-world surgical edge cases, causing physical injury.

classifications.evidence_quote: AI-powered surgery tool repeatedly injuring patients, lawsuits claim
classifications.recommended_action: Update G4 with this concrete example of an agentic AI system causing physical harm in a high-stakes medical context, and note implications for A3 and F3 regarding real-world brittleness and deployment scope.
